create_spanning_tree_crf: create a SpanningTreeCRF distribution from log potentials with directed, projective, and single_root_edge options
sample_spanning_trees: sample spanning trees from a SpanningTreeCRF distribution using a JAX random key
compute_log_prob: compute the log probability of a spanning tree event under a SpanningTreeCRF distribution
find_max_spanning_tree: find the maximum score spanning tree using argmax on a SpanningTreeCRF distribution
compute_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence between two SpanningTreeCRF distributions
